eindtekst: Pages v1: an automatic two-chart dashboard over the workspace's first table, with a chart detail view and the raw table below; the page builder itself is roadmap.

stappen.tekst: Pages v1 has no page list or builder yet. The dashboard is generated automatically from the first table in the workspace; the tour seeds a small demo table that sorts first.
Pages opens as a ready-made view: two clickable bar charts over the table's text and numeric columns, a filter bar, and the raw table underneath.
Clicking the top region bar selects it and fires a re-query across both charts and the table.
The selection flashes as a filter chip, but v1 then resets it: the refresh rebuilds the chart state and drops the filter. Selections that stick are on the roadmap.
Each chart card opens its own full-height detail view through the panel button in the card header.
The region chart opens on its own route, /pages/chart/region.
Same bar chart, full width, plus a right-hand drawer. The drawer is where chart configuration will live; v1 says so itself: configuration coming soon.
The Pages breadcrumb (or the arrow next to it) returns to the dashboard.
That is Pages today: automatic charts over the first table, live re-querying, a detail view and the table underneath. The page builder with bar, heatmap and table blocks is still roadmap.
